description:
## 1.36.0-dev.116 (2026-08-10)

- Reddit: use the post detail Compose container's native scroll action when the next comment is not yet composed.
- Reddit: preserve the logical selected comment while crossing a viewport boundary.
- Reddit: stop the old native-focus synchronizer from erasing the selector during boundary composition.
- Reddit: select the first newly visible parent or child comment after the native scroll completes.
- Reddit: retain the oversized preview bitmap crash guard from dev115.
